overview_description.description: Prom is a Web3 and blockchain infrastructure platform focused on building a scalable zkEVM network powered by Polygon CDK. The platform aims to bridge EVM and non-EVM blockchains while supporting decentralized applications, gaming NFTs, and cross-chain interoperability.
